description: This file contains SSL utility functions for OpenSSL error handling, version detection, and certificate chain setup within the net namespace, specifically for Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: SslSetClearMask
classes.description: A utility class for managing SSL set and clear flags.

classes.name: OpenSSLNetErrorLibSingleton
classes.description: Singleton class for managing OpenSSL error library registration.

methods.name: ConfigureFlag
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific SSL flag based on the boolean state.

methods.name: OpenSSLNetErrorLib
methods.description: Returns the error library identifier for net errors in OpenSSL.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLErrorSSL
methods.description: Maps OpenSSL SSL error codes to internal error codes.

methods.name: NetLogOpenSSLErrorParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of SSL error details for logging.

methods.name: OpenSSLPutNetError
methods.description: Logs a network error into OpenSSL's error queue.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLError
methods.description: Maps OpenSSL error codes to internal error codes, with error details.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLErrorWithDetails
methods.description: Maps OpenSSL errors to internal error codes, providing detailed error info.

methods.name: NetLogOpenSSLError
methods.description: Logs SSL errors with network log.

methods.name: GetNetSSLVersion
methods.description: Returns the internal representation of the SSL version used.

methods.name: SetSSLChainAndKey
methods.description: Sets the certificate chain and private key for an SSL connection.
